notes: SHAPE OF THE SECTION. Prelude (13.1 s, gentle but alive): Altman's footage + word-lit caption (2015), a paint-wipe into Amodei (2025) with his 25% and the 75% baseline, an origami fold into a pile of six real Hugging Face-incident screenshots that land on beats then 8ths (Jul 21 -> Oct 2, 'over 100 organizations'), pushed, lifted and circled through the breath. All the while a pencil classifier is sketched in the bottom strip: the plane on bar downbeats, an orange or blue data point stamped on every other beat, the cover's nabla/checker/target/square on later downbeats; a pencil frame boils round the footage. Riff (7.7 s, explosive): the whole prelude frame SHATTERS on the drop and the cover paints itself on the cream underneath; bar 1 = Coxon's audible 'restarted the thing, and it did it again' with his face inside the orbiting pink disc and beat-cut close-ups; bar 2 = the title painted on, the band turns into a river of vectors, every shape's colour turns fluid; a whole-art whip spin through the stop into bar 3 = the superposition burst with its exact equation.

VERSUS THE SHOWCASE (reviewed): the showcase's weak prelude beats were hb:-16, -14, -13, -12 and -8 (out/rev2/showcase-beatcheck.json); each now has a stamp or pencil stroke in the sketch strip plus a beat-locked mark or punch on the speaker (25% circle completing ON hb:-16, 'GO' on hb:-13, a shake on hb:-12, the underline completing ON hb:-10, '75%' painted ON hb:-9, punch + bloom on hb:-8). The pile grows from 3 to 6 shots and lands on 8ths in bar -1. The drop is a shatter (the illuminate is used nowhere else in this section). The riff carries one audible snippet.

TIMING CHECKS. Altman's pencil circle is on 'most likely' (8.42) rather than an underline under 'the end of the world' at 10.38, so the payoff lands > 0.5 s before his t1 (10.833) (coverage.py payoff rule; a mark cannot land before its phrase's last word). Amodei's '75%' paint moved from 15.05 to hb:-9 (14.877): complete 15.10, 0.75 s before the fold (hb:-7, 15.845); his underline completes ON hb:-10 (was 13.2-14.15). Coxon's karaoke holds to hb:9.25 (23.708) so its underline (complete 23.14) has 0.5 s. Olivia's spoken line (17.66-19.0) is never captioned and no clip speech plays after 14.53 until the riff (21.20).

AUDIO. Three audible voices: Altman 6.12-10.60 and Amodei 10.863-14.533 over the gentle intro (duck 5 dB), Coxon 21.20-23.08 over the riff (vocal-free 19.0-26.9; the riff is loud, so duck 9 dB, mix.py may raise it to 15). Coxon's 'again.' lands on hb:7.5 inside the riff's own stop (22.88-23.10), so the last word is in the clear. Before the mix, listen to 452.3-452.5 (the trimmed 'Like,') and re-run small.en on 450-456 s. The no-song version carries all three.

COXON CLAIM. This plan uses Coxon's 452.42-454.30 take ('…restarted the thing, and it did it again.'), audible, with his own picture in the pink disc. The old long cut used the same moment muted in the chorus (long.json ch-coxon); the chorus planner should not reuse it, so the cut does not show the same line twice.

SCREENSHOTS USED HERE (other planners: avoid): fortune-2026-07-21-openai-hf-escape, time-2026-07-24-lost-control, security-hf-header, bbc-2026-07-29-rogue-ai-hack-other-companies, frontier-rev2-wired_aug18_headline, frontier-rev2-gizmodo_oct2_headline. B-roll: coxon-daily-show 452.27-454.20, ale-agent-wall 72.0-75.2, xai-colossus-racks 34.0-37.2. Equation: superposition.

ORDER (= stacking, later on top): grounds, the shared paint and sketch canvases, Altman, Amodei, the pencil frame (above both clips), the sketch items, the pile; then kand-riff, the four kandclips (before fluid-riff: the first fill hook on a piece wins; the pink ones in time order, never overlapping), fluid-riff, the hero splat (drawn into the paint canvas under the art), Coxon voice/stamp/karaoke/credit, the equation, the riff credit, grain and paper last (as in the showcase).

LAYOUT. Prelude: footage box 1080x740 from y 380 (showcase layout.clipBox), stamp at y 300, caption from y 1160, Amodei's sub/source end ~y 1570; the sketch lives in the strip x 60-1020, y 1585-1850 (below the safe zone's text area; it is not text); beatfx prelude marks only in the strip above the stamp (y 150-270). Riff: the cover at layout {y 400, scale 0.72}; the top strip y 250-450 carries Coxon (hb:4-9.25) and later the equation (hb:12-16); the bottom line y 1500 carries the credits; the kicker sits at y 1373.

PIECES IN FOOTAGE. Pink: the agents wall hb:1.25-3.75, Coxon in sync hb:3.75-22.98, the agents wall again to hb:16; blue: the Colossus racks hb:3-16. The pink disc orbits with turn: false during Coxon's line, so his face stays upright (kandclip draws in the piece's transform); from hb:8 it turns. A beatfx 'jump' may squash it on a backbeat (accepted).

The SHORT's splice at song 26.477 cuts this section just before hb:15; its planner decides how kand-riff ends there.

COST. The heaviest frames are hb:0-1.5 (18-shard shatter of three full-frame layers + kand painting + beatfx) and bar 3 (superposition + fluid atlas + 2 kandclips + equation): expect ~0.5-0.7 s/frame on this box (showcase: 0.27-0.34 s in the prelude and riff, the 16-shard shatter frames ~0.7-1.0).
